propositions: A declarative metric registry maps each metric id to its lens, data source, and compute so the command is written once and new signals accrue without CLI changes.
A metric with no data yet returns Unavailable carrying a non-empty reason and an ISO accruing_since rather than being absent.
Each metric value carries a source in {structural, git, sidecar, snapshot, backfill_classified} and a confidence in {high, classified}.
is_authoritative('backfill_classified') is False so classified/backfilled values are excluded from authoritative structural rollups.
Every REGISTRY entry must have a unique id, a lens, a source, and a confidence.
